notes: Generated by tools/build-assets.mjs (recipe tools/assets/factors.mjs) from PDB 7PJV (pinned in tools/sources.lock.json; model 1, altloc . or A, no hydrogens, ligands/antibiotics/waters dropped).

Stored in the 7K00 ribo frame (bound pose = identity relative to ribosome-70s) via 23S rRNA P-atom superposition onto 7K00 frameAtoms (n 2749 -> 2600, kept 94.6%, RMSD 1.223 -> 0.777 A, 4 mismatches excluded).
Superposed on 23S rRNA P atoms only per DEC-010 (7PJV is a rotated hybrid-state ribosome; 16S+23S retains only 12.9%).
E. coli EF-G Walker A P-loop is canonically AHIDAGKT (Ala16 in place of Gly; 6.576 A from bound GDP in 7PJV, 15.313 A from 7K00 23S SRL).
Apramycin, GDP, Pi, ions, and waters dropped per PLAN.md 7.2.
